newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Swire Pacific sees rise in residential sales in 97.
newsitem.headline: Swire Pacific sees rise in residential sales in 97.

text.p: Swire Pacific Ltd said on Friday it expects contributions from its property division to post a significant rise in 1997.

"I would expect the contribution from the sale of residential properties to rise significantly in 1997 in light of the increase in the number of units to be offered for sale during the year and likely strong demand," chairman Peter Sutch said in a statement accompanying the company's 1996 results.

Sutch said the Hong Kong property market in 1996 exhibited renewed strength, which was reflected in "a marked increase in capital values and in sale prices for residential apartments and for office floors sold on a strata-title basis".
Property contributed HK$4.571 billion to the group's attributable profits in 1996, compared to HK$4.055 billion in 1995.
